notes: Stories refined and validated against code artifacts; no duplicates introduced.

change_log.value: Clarified Tier 1 vs Tier 2 contract boundaries, required fields, and validation rules including explicit transition flags
change_log.note: Tightened schema scope to reduce ambiguity in bug fixes

change_log.value: Expanded to include invalid transition blocking, retry handling, and session-based consent persistence edge cases
Added strict enforcement of consent gating before tool execution and standardized payload normalization
Expanded to include regression coverage for de-identification, consent revocation, and malformed tool inputs
Clarified enforcement of Tier 2 before PII persistence and alignment across lead_capture and unknown_question flows

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Validation Fixes
stories.description: Review and correct Pydantic models and data contracts for two-tier HIPAA consent, ensuring Tier 1 vs Tier 2 fields, flags, and transitions are explicitly defined, mutually exclusive where required, and validated with strict input enforcement.

stories.title: Core Consent State Machine Bug Fixes
stories.description: Fix defects in consent_service governing transitions between no consent, Tier 1 (de-identified), and Tier 2 (identified) states, including blocking invalid transitions, handling retries, partial consent states, and ensuring session-consistent consent persistence.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Routing Alignment
stories.description: Ensure tool_router and FastAPI layer enforce consent gating before any tool execution, normalize consent payloads, and prevent PHI leakage or bypass of required consent steps across all entry points.

stories.title: Consent Edge Case and Regression Test Suite
stories.description: Add unit and integration tests covering repeated prompts, denial flows, revocation, malformed inputs, session resets, and correct de-identification under Tier 1 to prevent regression of consent behavior.
stories.evidence: GAP: No dedicated consent regression suite exists in backend/tests; must be implemented

stories.title: Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
stories.description: Fix and enforce integration points where consent interacts with lead_capture and unknown_question services, ensuring Tier 2 consent is required before storing identifiable data and that all fallback flows respect consent boundaries.
